race.comment: EVIL EYE (5) was strongly fancied latest and proved too good with a 3.5 lengths win at this track in a handy 19.27. Awkwardly drawn but likes the trip. Some good form is emerging from his last run. Hard to fault recent form and looks a key chance again. MUMMA EASY (3) has a strong record this track and trip with nine wins and seven placings from 19 starts. Placed last time (19.19) at this track in a Free For All, finishing second and beaten a neck. Makes strong appeal on best. SCOTT GNARLY (2) was out of the placings last time when seventh at Sandown (30.48) but scored five back at The Meadows (30.03). Has a solid record over this journey. Yet to win out of this box but has been in the placings two times from four starts. In the mix. DAINTREE DAZZLER (1) gets a chance to redeem an unplaced effort here last start.
